title: Forgotten Shore
description:
A survival roguelike built from the ground up to be played with your eyes closed: keyboard-first and screen-reader-first. Works with NVDA and JAWS, and self-voices through SAPI without a screen reader.

You wake in chains on a frozen mountain road. Survive the night, then survive everything after it. Permadeath; your Aspect and Flaw emerge from how you play rather than a class you pick. Tactical combat on a real body model with wounds, blood, shock and lost functions; crafting, alchemy, soul-core progression and doctrines; generated places to hunt, explore and gather; markets, holdings, trials, achievements and optional online shared play. Three difficulties: Story, Standard and Nightmare.

An unofficial fan project inspired by the web novel Shadow Slave, not affiliated with its author or publisher; all writing, systems and audio are original.

This game is in development. A free demo for Windows is on its itch.io page.
